gloss: watchfulness; keeping an eye on things; vigilance

definitions.gloss: watchfulness; keeping an eye on things
definitions.explanation: The act of carefully observing one's surroundings and paying attention to multiple things at once.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}は{部下|ぶか}への{目配|めくば}りを{怠|おこた}らない。
examples.english: The boss doesn't neglect keeping an eye on subordinates.

examples.japanese: {店内|てんない}の{目配|めくば}りが{行|い}き{届|とど}いている。
examples.english: The store is thoroughly watched over.

examples.japanese: {会場|かいじょう}{全体|ぜんたい}に{目配|めくば}りをする。
examples.english: To keep an eye on the entire venue.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{目|め} (eye) + {配|くば}り (distribution) → distributing one's eyes = watchfulness

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{目配|めくば}りをする - to keep watch, to keep an eye on things
・{目配|めくば}りを{怠|おこた}らない - to not neglect watching
・{目配|めくば}りが{行|い}き{届|とど}く - to be thoroughly vigilant

NUANCE:
{目配|めくば}り emphasizes the visual aspect of attentiveness—scanning the environment, noticing details, and being aware of what's happening around you. Often used for managers, staff, or anyone responsible for overseeing a space or group.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
・{目|め}を{配|くば}る (verb) - to keep watch, be vigilant
・{気配|きくば}り - attentiveness to atmosphere/mood
